questions.stem: A circle in the $xy$-plane has its center at $(-4,1)$ and the point $(-8,4)$ lies on the circle. Which equation represents this circle?
In triangle $ABC$, angle $B$ is a right angle. The length of side $AB$ is $10\sqrt{41}$ and the length of side $BC$ is $24\sqrt{41}$. What is the length of side $AC$?

$35x+3=k(7x+3)+7x$

In the given equation, $k$ is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. Which value CANNOT be the value of $k$?
The $y$-intercept of the graph shown is $(x, y)$. What is the value of $y$?

figures.alt: Parabola opening upward, drawn on axes with x from -2 to 2 and y from -2 to 12 (labels every 2, gridline every 1). Its lowest point is a dot on the y-axis at y = 7, labelled as the y-intercept.

questions.stem:
$y = 45$ $y = 5x^2$

The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at the point $(x, y)$ in the xy-plane. What is a possible value of $x$?
In a unit circle with center $O$, the length of arc $AB$ is the value of $\frac{\pi}{4}$. What is the tangent of $\angle AOB$?

For a certain type of rope, the equation $y = 900ax^2$, where $a$ is a constant, gives the estimated breaking strength $y$, in pounds, of a rope with a circumference of $x$ inches. Based on this equation, if a rope of this type has a circumference of $2.75$ inches, it has an estimated breaking strength of $9,528.75$ pounds. What is the estimated breaking strength, in pounds, of a rope of this type that has a circumference of $8.50$ inches?
If $\dfrac{x+6}{3}=\dfrac{x+6}{13}$, the value of $x+6$ is between which of the following pairs of values?

$$\begin{array}{|l|c|}\hline \text{Average pitching speed} & \text{Number of pitches} \\ \hline \text{At least 30 mph but less than 35 mph} & 12 \\ \hline \text{At least 35 mph but less than 40 mph} & 7 \\ \hline \text{At least 40 mph but less than 45 mph} & 6 \\ \hline \text{At least 45 mph but less than 50 mph} & 1 \\ \hline\end{array}$$
The table summarizes the distribution of average pitching speed, in miles per hour (mph), for a sample of 26 pitches in a youth softball league.
According to the table, how many pitches in the sample have an average pitching speed of at least 30 mph but less than 35 mph?

The table shows the exponential relationship between the number of years, $x$, since Hana started training in pole vault and the estimated height $h(x)$, in meters, of her best pole vault for that year.
$\begin{array}{c|c} x & h(x) \\ \hline 0 & 1.23 \\ 2 & 1.54 \\ 4 & 1.94 \end{array}$
Which of the following functions best represents this relationship, where $x \le 4$ ?

A student needs at least 50 signatures from classmates to run for class president. The student collects 35 signatures on Monday and collects enough additional signatures on Tuesday to run for class president. Which inequality represents the number of additional signatures, $s$, that the student collects on Tuesday?

$\begin{array}{c|c} x & g(x) \\ \hline -27 & 3 \\ -9 & 0 \\ 21 & 5 \end{array}$
The table shows three values of $x$ and their corresponding values of $g(x)$, where $g(x) = \dfrac{f(x)}{x + 3}$ and $f$ is a linear function. What is the $y$-intercept of the graph of $y = f(x)$ in the $xy$-plane?
$$18qrt-2qrs+10rst=0$$ In the given equation, $q$, $r$, $s$, and $t$ are positive, and $\dfrac{q}{t}$ is greater than $5$. Which expression is equivalent to $s$?
Which expression is equivalent to $6x^2+18x$?
At what point $(x,y)$ do the graphs of the equations $y=3x+1$ and $y=4x-6$ intersect in the $xy$-plane?
The expression $\sqrt{486+44\sqrt{2}}$ is equivalent to the expression $r+p^{\frac{1}{2}}$, where $r$ and $p$ are positive integers. What is the value of $r+p$?
What is the area, in square centimeters, of a rectangle with a length of 34 centimeters (cm) and a width of 29 cm?
For a function $f$, $f(-12)=\frac{17}{3}$ and $f(6)=-\frac{1}{3}$. Which equation could define $f$?

In $2022$, the population of American spadefoot toads in a monitored area was estimated to be $20\%$ more than in $2021$, and in $2023$, the population was estimated to be $17\%$ more than in $2022$. If the population of American spadefoot toads in this area was estimated to be $t$ times as much in $2021$ as in $2023$, which of the following is closest to the value of $t$?

A model estimates that the initial number of photons in an X-ray beam is $600$ when the beam reaches the surface of a certain material. The model also estimates that when the beam passes through this material, the number of photons in the beam decreases by $50\%$ for each $13$ millimeters of the material the beam passes through. Which equation represents this model, where $I$ is the estimated number of photons in the beam when the beam reaches a point $x$ millimeters from the surface?
If $6 + x = 70$, what is the value of $48 + 8x$?

A dance studio charges an introductory fee for the first $3$ lessons and then charges a fixed fee for each additional lesson. One student took $4$ lessons and was charged \$60. Another student took $16$ lessons and was charged \$300. Which function $f$ gives the total charge, in dollars, for any student who took $x$ lessons, where $x > 3$?
If $\sin x=\frac{3}{5}$ and $\cos x<0$, find $\tan x$.
Which of the following is a factor of the expression $2x^2 + (18r + 5)x + 45r$, where $r$ is a nonzero constant? I. $x + 9r$ II. $2x + 5$

A sample of 40 fourth-grade students was selected at random from a certain school. The 40 students completed a survey about the morning announcements, and 32 thought the announcements were helpful. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the survey can be applied?

options.B: All fourth-grade students at the school
options.D: All fourth-grade students in the county in which the school is located

questions.stem:
$y = 5x^2 - 40x + 35$

The given equation represents a parabola in the $xy$-plane. Which of the following equations that represent the same parabola displays the x-intercepts as constants or coefficients?

The table summarizes the distribution of age and assigned group for $90$ participants in a study.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{0–9 years} & \text{10–19 years} & \text{20+ years} & \text{Total}\\\hline \text{Group A} & 7 & 14 & 9 & 30\\\hline \text{Group B} & 6 & 4 & 20 & 30\\\hline \text{Group C} & 17 & 12 & 1 & 30\\\hline \text{Total} & 30 & 30 & 30 & 90\\\hline\end{array}$$

One of these participants will be selected at random. What is the probability of selecting a participant from group A, given that the participant is at least $10$ years of age? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction, not as a percent.)

An office supply store sells desks at a discount to customers who purchase at least 5 desks. For a purchase of $x$ desks, the price per desk $y$, in dollars, is given by the equation $y=500-5x$, where $5\leq x\leq30$. Which statement is the best interpretation of $(x,y)=(6,470)$ in this context?

options.A: A customer purchasing 6 desks will pay a total of 470 dollars.
options.B: A customer purchasing 6 desks will receive a discount of 470 dollars.
options.C: A customer purchasing 6 desks will pay 470 dollars for each desk.
options.D: A customer purchasing 470 desks will receive a discount of 6 dollars on each desk.

questions.stem: A number $x$ is at most $27$ less than $3$ times the value of $y$. If the value of $y$ is $8$, what is the greatest possible value of $x$?
